--- /workspace/embed_bug.py
+++ /workspace/embed_bug.py
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
@@ -1,0 +6,60 @@
+try:
+    import piexif
+except Exception as e:
+    print("This script requires the 'piexif' package. Install it with: pip install piexif", file=sys.stderr)
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+
+def encode_user_comment(text: str) -> bytes:
+    try:
+        text.encode("ascii")
+        return b"ASCII\x00\x00\x00" + text.encode("ascii")
+    except UnicodeEncodeError:
+        return b"UNICODE\x00" + text.encode("utf-16-be")
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Embed a text payload into a JPEG's EXIF UserComment field."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("image", help="Path to the input JPEG image")
+    parser.add_argument("payload", help="Text payload to embed into EXIF UserComment")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "-o",
+        "--output",
+        help="Optional output JPEG path. If omitted, modifies the input file in place.",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    in_path = args.image
+    out_path = args.output
+
+    if not os.path.isfile(in_path):
+        print(f"Input file not found: {in_path}", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    try:
+        exif_dict = piexif.load(in_path)
+    except Exception:
+        exif_dict = {"0th": {}, "Exif": {}, "GPS": {}, "1st": {}, "thumbnail": None}
+
+    if not isinstance(exif_dict.get("Exif"), dict):
+        exif_dict["Exif"] = {}
+
+    exif_dict["Exif"][piexif.ExifIFD.UserComment] = encode_user_comment(args.payload)
+
+    try:
+        exif_bytes = piexif.dump(exif_dict)
+        if out_path:
+            piexif.insert(exif_bytes, in_path, out_path)
+            print(f"Embedded UserComment into: {out_path}")
+        else:
+            piexif.insert(exif_bytes, in_path)
+            print(f"Embedded UserComment into: {in_path}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Failed to write EXIF data: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
